_meta.description: Post-split baseline: measured from the four separate entry points, for tracking future regressions from this point forward. NOT the pre-split measurement — see HISTORICAL_PRE_SPLIT_AGGREGATE in this script and AUDIT_REMEDIATION_AND_RELEASE_PLAN.md 5.1. Re-measured DOWNWARD for the 1.4.x line: gen-locales.mjs stopped embedding `sources`, which was 94% of the locale payload by raw bytes and no rule reads. text 88.7 -> 19.7 KB gzip, yaml 90.6 -> 21.6, html 137.9 -> 68.6, index and markdown 234.7 -> 165.5. The budget now guards a much smaller number, which is the point: re-embedding the citations would trip it immediately rather than hiding inside a quarter-megabyte of prose.
